purpose: Convert a passed Stage A answer and its framework-resolved verbatim evidence into knowledge-graph-ready atomic ESG claims without reopening the full report.
model_input: Stage A task id and answer
Only Stage A resolved evidence handles and verbatim excerpts
Frozen ontology identifiers and canonical-unit identifiers
deterministic_validation: Stage A archive checksums must verify before use.
Evidence handles must be a subset of Stage A resolved evidence.
verbatim_value must occur literally in the selected evidence after whitespace normalization.
Numeric normalized_value must equal a numeric token in verbatim_value after comma removal.
period_year must occur in the evidence text or immutable MinerU table_header_context supplied by Stage A.
metric_id, canonical_unit, and scope_id must belong to the frozen ontology registry.
knowledge_graph_projection: Framework creates an observation node and deterministic subject--reports--observation, observation--metric--metric_id, observation--period--period_year, and observation--scope--scope_id edges only after validation.
prohibited: No full-report access in Stage B.
No hidden simulated reference in the model request.
No invented evidence handle or ontology id.
No posthoc value, year, unit, metric, subject, or scope repair.
No claim that evidence-linked semantic fields are independently verified by a human.
